g.text: 💡 Spring Boot Backend Structure Quick Reference
Presentation layer: Exposes HTTP endpoints (@RestController for API, @Controller for web)
Business logic layer: @Service, @Transactional domain operations and business validation
Persistence layer: Spring Data JPA interfaces extending JpaRepository<T, ID>
Database domain entities: @Entity, @Table mappings, foreign keys, and domain enums
Data Transfer Objects: Immutable Java records with Jakarta @Valid annotations for contracts
Configuration (application.properties), Flyway DB migrations (db/migration), and templates
